high_level_description: This image is a promotional poster for a production titled "Prima Facie," which is part of the National Theatre Live series. The poster features a stylized, artistic representation of a person with long hair, partially obscured by vibrant, overlapping colors of red and blue. The individual appears to be wearing a dark outfit, and their face is shown in a close-up view, with one eye closed and the other open, conveying a sense of intensity or emotion. The text on the poster includes: "National Theatre Live" at the top left corner.
